title: [finding] AdminScope.manageBindings and authorEnvironmentSets are honoured by no write path after C3; the ADR-0090 D9/D12 junction gates are unmeasured; permissions docs describe removed gates
body:
Ruled: 6181988435 · letter A · 2026-10-15T01:05Z

Filing gate **①**, class (b), declared ≠ enforced: the enforce-or-remove channel. Filed by `domain:engine` seat 2 (#20966) · `os-steve` · `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX` at #22975's landing (8-post, PR #23428 → `0d3ea295d1`), as the seat review 6124054616 (finding 1) and the contract record 6162274013 (item 5) provide. Domain and area are triage's call: the positions span `packages/spec`, `plugin-security` and `content/docs`.

## Positions (read on `main` at `0d3ea295d1`)
1. **`AdminScope.manageBindings` and `AdminScope.authorEnvironmentSets` are declared and honoured by no write path.**
   - The keys are declared in `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts:92-93` and authorable in a permission set's `adminScope` (ADR-0090 D12; the form at `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts:62`). The metadata form's help text (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts:2326`) tells authors that they grant binding and environment-set authoring.
   - `delegated-admin-gate.ts` still parses them (`:213`, `:519`, `:883`) and compares them in strict containment (`:893`).
   - But C3 retired the two objects they governed: `sys_position_permission_set` (the binding) and `sys_permission_set` (env-set authoring). Their gates left with them (`assertBindingWrite`, `assertSetAuthoring`). A position's sets are now part of its definition (ADR-0131 D3). Authoring a permission set is an environment metadata write, judged by `manage_metadata`, not by a delegate's scope.
   - So an author can declare a delegate who "may bind" or "may author env sets", and no door honours it.
2. **The ADR-0090 D9 (guest) and D12 junction gates are not measured on the new model.**
   - The D5/D7 door counterparts are pinned (`suggested-binding-acceptance.dogfood.test.ts`: the risky accept answers 403, and `PUT /meta/position/everyone` answers 403).
   - D9's guest binding and D12's delegate gates had their junction-row enforcement removed with the junction, and no carrier re-states them against the definition write (record 6162274013, ③).
3. **Text that still describes the removed gates.**
   - `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx`, `permission-sets.mdx` and `positions.mdx` name `sys_position_permission_set`, `assertBindingWrite`, `assertSetAuthoring` or the walled data door.
   - `examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts` around line 360: "Guest bindings face the STRICTEST lint tier" is false, because the lint covers `everyone` suggestions only. "Binding is an ADMIN action (Setup → bind `guest`)" is false, because no door binds a set to `guest`. Found in PR #23428's scoped record 6168265130.

## Wanted
- **Positions 1 and 2:** enforce or remove, under ADR-0049. Either the definition write judges the delegate's `manageBindings` (a delegate edits a position's `permissionSets` only inside its subtree and allowlist) and `authorEnvironmentSets`, or the two keys retire through the ADR-0087 route with the forms, help text and pins that a removal needs (`spec-property-retirement`). Which one is a product question when the measurement shows no user. Per the four axes, the default with zero pull is to retire.
- **Position 3:** correct the text to the model on `main`. This is docs-accuracy class, with no contract change.
- One pin per position kept, or the ADR-0087 marker per key retired.

## Not here
- ADR-0094 and ADR-0138's rows: corrected by #23412 (`be50633be1`).
- `PermissionSet.description`'s liveness evidence: #23404.

Dedupe: no open card names these keys or pages. The search covered `manageBindings`, `authorEnvironmentSets` and the permissions pages; #23323 and #22379 are closed and cover other sentences.
